name: Staged: MINNEN on the left wall, desk in the window corner with BESTÅ storage above, TROFAST divider facing the play floor
notes:
Staged pick, re-reviewed 2026-10-23 for F-63. The plan was right (bed in the protected corner, desk in the daylight corner, play floor in the middle), so two targeted changes: closed BESTÅ storage on the empty wall above the desk, and the TROFAST moved out of the 9" slot in front of the heater to a low divider facing the play floor. 13 placed, 9 extras.
bed-1 MINNEN (fully extended, 77.5"), head on the top wall, long side on the left wall, flush (IKEA: under 2 1/2" or over 9" from a wall): F-34 open side 41" to the desk chair and open floor below, narrowing to 25.9" at its foot corner to the TROFAST; F-33 bedding 71.5" from the heater face.
dresser-1 GODISHUS 3-drawer beside the bed's head as the bedside table (23 5/8" high): F-32 24"+ of open floor in front; F-21 anchor it (IKEA: "must be securely anchored").
desk-1 FLISAT on the top wall in the window corner: F-33 right end 6" from the heater face; F-35 30" chair zone clear behind it (y 25.6 to 55.6), the chair 19.5" from the heater, not backed against a heater wall; 3 1/8" from the dresser. chair-1 SUNDVIK pulled out at the desk ("Last chance" at IKEA: buy it with the desk).
cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 47 1/4x16 1/2x15" (top, new): top wall above the desk, x 58.75-106, its right end 6" short of the heater face (F-33): closed storage hung above her reach for markers, paint, glue and rotation toys a parent hands down (F-63): solid LAPPVIKEN doors (no glass, F-21), hung on 2 BESTÅ suspension rails screwed into studs (extras), underside about 54" up. The canvas art moves off this wall to make room.
toys-1 TROFAST as a low divider, rot 180, x 66.4-103, y 77.1-94.5, boxes facing the play floor: its back sits on the closet doors' swing line without entering it and the 24" in front of the closet stays clear (F-31); F-32 39" in front of the boxes to the desk chair; its end 9" from the heater face (F-33), and no open back toward the heater now, so toys cannot drop into a slot beside it. Reach the closet's right half around its left end: 36.4" between it and the door's swing. Flag: assumed-position:closet.
books-1 FLISAT book display at the bed's foot, covers facing the door, 2.5" short of the door's swing (F-31). Flag: assumed-position:door.
rug-1 VALLABY road-map rug, rot 90, x 41-93, y 38-77: the play floor, 19" from the heater face (F-33), out of both swings, clear of the desk chair, the desk and the TROFAST, so nothing stands on its edge.
canopy-1 LÖVA on the top wall over the bed's head (the bed is the reading nook, with the book display at its foot); mount it out of her reach (IKEA). lamp-1 UPPLYST on the left wall over the bed as her reading light, cord fastened to the wall (IKEA). nightlight-1 TÖVÄDER and plant-1 FEJKA (artificial) on the dresser. art-1 BLODFLÄDER (canvas, no glass, F-21) on the left wall above the book display, at her eye level, 1.5" clear of the open door.
Maddie is 4 (F-21): every piece within her reach is under 27" or anchored (the GODISHUS carries IKEA's anchor warning at 23 5/8", so it is anchored too); no glass anywhere; no loft or bunk.
Walkways (F-30): door to room 45" between the book display and the TROFAST; bed to desk 41"; around the TROFAST to the closet 36.4".
Extras: VIMSIG mattress and BARNDRÖM fitted sheet in the frame, SMÅSPORRE insert, BARNDRÖM cover, low pillow, SKOGSDUVA cushions x2, BENGTA panel (cut to clear the heater, F-33) on the HUGAD rod (assumed-position:window), BESTÅ suspension rails x2. Not placed: nothing.
Total $1,189.30: placed $817.88 + extras $371.42; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
